column1: # NCZ capability feature map: tier -> default value.
#   feature  kind      target                            T0         T1         T2          T3
#   gsetting  target is <schema-id>:<key>.  The tier value becomes a *system
#             `gsettings set` still wins, so this only changes DEFAULTS.
#   env       target is an environment variable written to
#             feed and the thermal governor (systemd user services + PAM).
#   flag      target is a flag written to /etc/ncz/capability/features.env,
# The values were chosen so a measured-HEALTHY old machine keeps its effects:
# T2 is the stock Singularity look (effects on); T3 adds the blur material;
# T1/T0 are the deliberate reductions for machines that measure too slow.
